description: This file defines and registers Prometheus metrics related to FIFO queue processing in Kubernetes, including gauges and histograms for queued items and processing latency, along with metric provider implementations.

classes.name: fifoMetricsProvider
classes.description: Implements methods to create new queued item and processing latency metrics, serving as a provider for FIFO metrics.

classes.name: reservedGaugeMetric
classes.description: Wraps a gauge metric to update only if the associated informer ID is still reserved.

classes.name: reservedHistogramMetric
classes.description: Wraps a histogram metric to update only if the associated informer ID is still reserved.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers FIFO metrics with the legacy registry, ensuring they are only registered once.

methods.name: NewQueuedItemMetric
methods.description: Creates a new gauge metric for queued items associated with a specific informer.

methods.name: NewProcessingLatencyMetric
methods.description: Creates a new histogram metric for processing latency associated with a specific informer.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the value of the gauge metric if the informer ID is still reserved.

methods.name: Observe
methods.description: Records an observation for the histogram metric if the informer ID is still reserved.
